note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-5 English Wikipedia article 'FV510 Warrior'. The article is a secondary compilation, so every value is grade claimed and the registry marks primary_held false. It holds the FV510 Warrior infantry fighting vehicle as a tracked entry. It publishes identity, the mass, the overall length, width and height, the engine model, the engine rating of 550 hp with no net basis, the maximum road speed and the operational range. It publishes no ground clearance, no track shoe width, no track pitch, no transmission class and no grouser statement, so the entry is not runtime-ready. No stronger source is held: no UK AESP or maker datasheet for the Warrior is on the two manual mirrors that served the other captures.

operating_weight_kg.state: mass published as 25.4 tonnes (25.0 long tons; 28.0 short tons); recorded as 25,400 kg with the tonne taken as 1,000 kg; the article states no kerb or gross weight

length_mm.state: overall length, published as 6.3 m (20 ft 8 in); the published metre figure used directly

height_mm.state: overall height, published as 2.8 m (9 ft 2 in); the published metre figure used directly

published_power_hp.state: engine published as a Perkins V-8 Condor Diesel, 550 hp (410 kW), with no net basis
